text: As the Toronto Transit Commission (TTC) operates a transit service on O'Connor Drive, City Council approval of this report is required. Transportation Services is requesting approval for the installation of on-street paid parking on O'Connor Drive, between Garden Crescent and Yardley Avenue. This request is to help offset the temporary loss of on-street paid parking in the St. Clair Avenue East and O'Connor Drive area due to the City's Engineering and Construction Services capital work tied with the Basement Flooding Protection Program. Transportation Services and Toronto Parking Authority (TPA) staff reviewed streets near St. Clair Avenue East and O'Connor Drive to convert locations with daytime time limit parking, overnight permit parking and no parking regulations, to on-street paid parking.
